newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka awards June 27-28 diesel, jet to Vitol.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka awards June 27-28 diesel, jet to Vitol.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded its tender to buy June 27-28 gas oil and jet to Dutch trader, Vitol London, a company official said on Friday.
Vitol sold the 250,000 barrels of 1.0 percent sulphur gas oil at a discount of 11.5 cents a barrel to Singapore spot quote on a cost and freight basis (c-and-f) Colombo basis.
The 50,000 barrels of jet was sold at a discount of 6.5 cents to Singapore spot quotes c-and-f.
The tender closed on June 11 and was valid for two days.
In its last tender for June 21-22 delivery, CPC purchased 220,000 barrels of gasoil and 80,000 barrels of jet from French major Total at a 10-cent discount c-and-f Colombo.

This is the fourth June delivery gas oil cargo that CPC has bought since the unexpected shutdown of its 55,000 barrels-per-day Sapugaskandan refinery for 11 days from May 30, after its single point mooring buoy was damaged in an accident.
The refinery resumed operations on Tuesday.
Sri Lanka normally imports two to three cargoes of middle distillates each month.

The official said the CPC plans to award its outstanding tender to buy July 12-13 delivery gas oil and jet supplies next week. The tender is scheduled to close June 18 and offers should be valid for two days.
